title: bidens pilosa f. decumbens
intro: Bidens pilosa f. decumbens, commonly known as creeping beggar ticks, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. It is a creeping annual herb with leaves that have a serrated edge, and it has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing and the management of fever. The bioactive constituents of B. pilosa f. decumbens include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
